argument_provenance.rejection_reason: AutoScan is an ECU discovery diagnostic operation (22 04 A1), not a coding setting.
ClearDiagnosticInformation is an atomic UDS service (14 FF FF FF), not a coding setting.
EPB is a service tool with RoutineControl 0x03A1/0x03A0, not a coding setting.
DPF is a service tool with RoutineControl 0x053D, not a coding setting.
Battery registration is a service routine, not a normal customization setting.
Service reset is a service routine, not a normal customization setting.

The effect of this customization depends on the front lights installed:
Xenon plus: high beams tilt up above 140 km/h (90 mph).
Others: low beams turn on automatically above 140 km/h (90 mph).
Note that this works only if your power mirror switch is set to control the passenger-side mirror.
This customization may fail to save on some cars. If it does, that means your car doesn't support it.
